create_judge_engine: create a judge engine using LiteLLM with a default Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct model or custom LLMEngineConfig
create_ToolCheckerParam: create a ToolCheckerParam dataclass to configure hard judge parameter checking with arg name, checker type, and tool name
create_SoftToolJudgeConfig: create a SoftToolJudgeConfig dataclass to configure soft tool judging with an LLM engine and content checker types
create_ScriptedGraphPerEventJudgeConfig: create a ScriptedGraphPerEventJudgeConfig dataclass to configure scripted graph event judging with required event ID checker parameters
create_InContextJudgeConfig: create an InContextJudgeConfig dataclass to configure in-context judging with time thresholds and per-tool evaluation criteria
